final_text: {"proposed_outcome":"ESCALATE","findings":[{"text":"The event is an upload action.","evidence_id":"EVENT"},{"text":"The destination is a personal cloud-storage service hosted at icloud.com using a personal account.","evidence_id":"DESTINATION"},{"text":"The file is classified Internal with high confidence.","evidence_id":"CLASSIFICATION"},{"text":"The policy status is conflict review with unknown effect because the supplied policy claims conflict.","evidence_id":"POLICY"},{"text":"One current policy section states that uploading company information classified Internal or above to a personal cloud-storage account is prohibited.","evidence_id":"E1"},{"text":"Another current policy section states that employees may store Internal information in a personal cloud-storage account when working remotely if the account is protected with multi-factor authentication.","evidence_id":"E2"},{"text":"A current DLP policy section states that a business need that conflicts with the policy requires a DLP exception request approved by the data owner and the Head of Data Protection.","evidence_id":"E3"},{"text":"No approved DLP exception was found for this user and destination covering this event.","evidence_id":"EXCEPTION"},{"text":"The user is a privileged employee with the role VP Engineering.","evidence_id":"IDENTITY"},{"text":"Recent behavior is in the ELEVATED band and includes a new destination signal.","evidence_id":"BEHAVIOR"},{"text":"In the last 7 days, the user had 1 recent external upload, 200 MB of downloads versus a 220 MB baseline, and 3 sensitive file accesses.","evidence_id":"ACTIVITY"}],"missing_evidence":[]}
